   **Pricing and paywall.**

      Review window: Aug 17, 2026 - Aug 21, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Melissa Audirsch_, Aug 19, 2026, 1/5: "Do not download this app! It is not a real company, they will take your money, charge you a monthly subscription fee, and when you try to cancel it they will give you the run around and tell you that they can't find your account and you will not be able to cancel your subscription. STAY AWAY!!!!!"
            2. _Sandra Fry_, Aug 17, 2026, 1/5: "I need to cancel my subscription. I cant afford this any longer I've lost my job."
            3. _B “Ilovetacos” R_, Aug 21, 2026, 4/5: "The app itself is great. It is just too expensive for my budget. When I did have a problem figuring part of it out, Kate Brown in the support area was quick to respond, had everything I needed all in one conversation. No need for multiple back and forths. Overall it's a great app and the workouts are easy to follow, well explained and adaptable."
